spaceSettings.title: Space settings
spaceSettings.general.title: General
spaceSettings.general.description: Name and description of this Space. The changes are saved to the Space for everyone.
spaceSettings.general.nameTooLong: Use at most 120 characters for the name.
spaceSettings.general.descriptionTooLong: Use at most 1000 characters for the description.
spaceSettings.general.stale: This Space changed while you were editing. Reload to see the latest version.
spaceSettings.general.personalReadOnly: Your Personal space cannot be renamed or described here.
spaceSettings.general.readOnly: You can view this Space but cannot change its name or description.
spaceSettings.general.discardDescription: Your unsaved changes to this Space will be lost.
spaceSettings.general.visibilityHint: Who can see this Space. Public and Private visibility are not available yet.
spaceSettings.general.visibilityPersonal: Only you can see this Personal space.
spaceSettings.general.visibilityShared: Visible to the people and groups it is shared with.
spaceSettings.general.lockedHint: A locked Space is restricted. Only Workspace admins can change this.
spaceSettings.general.notLockedHint: Workspace admins can lock this Space from its menu.
spaceSettings.members.title: Members & access
spaceSettings.members.description: Who can see and work in this Space, and at which role.
spaceSettings.members.personal: A Personal space has only you as a member.
spaceSettings.members.noPermission: Only people who can share this Space can change its members.
spaceSettings.customFields.noPermission: Only people who can manage this Space's fields can change them.
spaceSettings.tools.title: Tools
spaceSettings.tools.description: Boards, tables, dashboards, reports and calendars are added and arranged on the Space page.
spaceSettings.itemTypes.title: Custom item types
spaceSettings.itemTypes.description: Item types available in this Space and the Workspace.
spaceSettings.workflows.title: Workflows
spaceSettings.workflows.description: Workflows used by items in this Space are set in Workspace workflow settings.
spaceSettings.automation.title: Automation
spaceSettings.automation.description: Rules that run on items in this Space.
spaceSettings.forms.title: Request forms
spaceSettings.forms.description: Forms people use to send requests into this Space.
spaceSettings.blueprints.title: Blueprints
spaceSettings.members.empty: Nobody has access yet except through admins.
spaceSettings.members.ruleUnion: Direct shares and group shares are combined: a person gets everything any of their grants allows.
spaceSettings.members.ruleUserType: The user type sets a ceiling; a higher space role cannot exceed it.
spaceSettings.members.ruleItems: Item and field permissions are set per item and per field, not here.
spaceSettings.members.ruleJobRole: A job role is information only. It never grants access.
spaceSettings.general.noActiveAdmin: This Space has no active Space Admin. Work continues; archiving and naming admins are unavailable until one is active again.
spaceSettings.general.archivedNote: This Space is archived. It is read-only: items, settings and history are kept.
spaceSettings.lifecycle.title: Visibility and archive
spaceSettings.lifecycle.description: Only Workspace admins and Space Admins can change these.
spaceSettings.lifecycle.publicHint: Public: people in this Workspace who are allowed can find it and join with Read access.
spaceSettings.lifecycle.privateHint: Private: only people who are given access can see it.
spaceSettings.lifecycle.archiveHint: Stops changes and automation. Items, settings and history stay.
spaceSettings.lifecycle.restoreHint: Brings the Space back. Automation and forms need a check first.
spaceSettings.lifecycle.confirm.public.d: People in this Workspace who are allowed can find “{{name}}” and join with Read access.
New people can no longer find or join “{{name}}”. People who already have access keep it.
The Space becomes read-only. Items, settings and history are kept. Automation and forms stop.
The Space becomes editable again. Check automation and forms afterwards.
spaceSettings.admins.title: Space Admins
spaceSettings.admins.description: Space Admins manage members, visibility and archive. A Full member is not an admin unless named here.
spaceSettings.discover.title: Public Spaces
spaceSettings.discover.description: Public Spaces in this Workspace you can join. Joining gives you Read access.
spaceSettings.direct.title: Direct access
spaceSettings.direct.description: Add or remove people and groups directly on this Space, and change their role. Access from a group stays while the group keeps it.
spaceSettings.direct.stale: The access list changed. It was reloaded; check it and try again.
spaceSettings.direct.removeDescription: This person or group loses direct access to this Space.
spaceSettings.direct.removeKeepsGroup: This removes the direct share only. Access through {{groups}} stays.
spaceSettings.registry.emptyDescription: Spaces you can see or manage appear here.
spaceSettings.tools.empty: This Space has no tools yet.
spaceSettings.tools.manageHint: Add, rename, duplicate, delete and reorder tools from the Space page toolbar.
spaceSettings.workflows.saved: Default saved. Existing items keep their workflow.
spaceSettings.workflows.readOnly: Only people who can edit this Space can change its default workflows.
spaceSettings.blueprints.empty: Blueprints are reusable structures for creating items. Save an item as a blueprint, then reuse it here or on the Blueprints page.
spaceSettings.delete.projects: {{count}} projects or folders in this Space will be removed.
spaceSettings.delete.onlyHere: {{count}} items exist only here and will be removed.
spaceSettings.delete.elsewhere: {{count}} items also live in other Spaces and stay there.
spaceSettings.delete.people: {{members}} people and {{groups}} groups lose access to this Space.
spaceSettings.delete.automation: {{count}} automation rules belong to this Space.
spaceSettings.delete.forms: {{count}} request forms belong to this Space.
spaceSettings.delete.impactError: The impact could not be checked. Try again before deleting.
spaceSettings.admins.lastAdmin: Cannot remove the only Space Admin. Assign another admin first.
spaceSettings.admins.selfDescription: After this you cannot manage this Space's admins or settings unless another admin gives you admin access back.
spaceSettings.direct.savedKeepsGroup: Role saved. The effective role may stay the same, because a group also gives {{groups}} access.

form.ownership.internalHint: Shared inside the workspace, not tied to a Customer.
